en: A black-and-white postcard showing a large, classical-style two‑storey stone building behind a metal fence and gate. The facade has many evenly spaced windows and a central entrance with a pediment. Conifer trees and other vegetation stand in front, and tree branches frame the image from above. The word "LÄNSRESIDENS" is visible on the building, and a printed caption at the bottom left reads "Umeå. Länsresidenset."
